title: DEER of Singly Labelled Proteins to Evaluate Supramolecular Packing of Amyloid Fibrils
authors: Tsay K; Equbal A; Li Y; Tsui T; Han S; Fichou Y
one_liner_zh: 该文用DEER光谱评估tau淀粉样纤维的超分子堆积有序度，对象为淀粉样纤维（含IDR tau）但非PPI互作机制建模，方法为实验光谱而非AI/物理模拟，仅对纤维堆积表征有间接启发。
abstract:
1 The formation of protein amyloid fibrils in the brain is a hallmark of various neurodegenerative diseases, including Alzheimer diseases and Parkinson diseases. Amyloid fibrils are highly ordered aggregates in which proteins folded in two-dimensional layers stack along one axis to form elongated linear assemblies. The specific conformations adopted by the proteins within each layer of the amyloid correlates with the pathology. Furthermore, their spreading and templating competency relies on strict in register packing of the folded proteins along the fibril growing axis. There is a need for tools to characterize not only the protein fold across the fibril cross section but also the spatial ordering of the proteins stacked along the amyloid fibril axis. We present an approach based on double electron electron resonance spectroscopy (DEER) using singly labelled tau protein assembled in amyloid fibrils that can deliver an apparent dimensionality of the supramolecular organization of tau fibrils. The parameters of the DEER background function can be used to assess the amyloid core location and packing order, and track time-resolved formation of aggregation intermediates. Showcasing the method on tau, we demonstrate that heparin-induced tau fibrils are mispacked while seeded aggregation can template amyloid fibrils with a higher packing order. This study benchmarks a new method that will provide critical structural insights into amyloid assemblies.

Abstract Figure

DEER-derived dimensionality parameter differentiates between spin-labelled tau protein in solution, in perfectly aligned fibril or in imperfectly aligned fibril (fibril structure edited from PDB 6qjh).
abstract_zh:
1 大脑中蛋白质淀粉样纤维的形成是多种神经退行性疾病（包括阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病）的标志。淀粉样纤维是高度有序的聚集体，其中蛋白质以二维层状折叠，并沿一轴堆叠形成细长的线性组装体。淀粉样纤维每层内蛋白质采用的特异性构象与病理相关。此外，其传播和模板化能力依赖于沿纤维生长轴严格对齐的折叠蛋白质的注册堆积。需要工具来表征不仅跨越纤维横截面的蛋白质折叠，还表征沿淀粉样纤维轴堆叠的蛋白质的空间有序性。我们提出了一种基于双电子电子共振光谱（DEER）的方法，使用组装在淀粉样纤维中的单标记tau蛋白，能够提供tau纤维超分子组织的表观维度。DEER背景函数的参数可用于评估淀粉样核心位置和堆积顺序，并追踪时间分辨的聚集中间体形成。以tau为对象展示该方法，我们证明肝素诱导的tau纤维存在错误堆积，而种子聚集可以模板化具有更高堆积顺序的淀粉样纤维。本研究基准化了一种新方法，将为淀粉样组装体提供关键的结构见解。

摘要图

DEER衍生的维度参数区分了溶液中的自旋标记tau蛋白、完美对齐纤维或不完美对齐纤维中的tau蛋白（纤维结构编辑自PDB 6qjh）。
